page_title: NET 2-2 ARG (PEN: 3-4) | Netherlands v Argentina 09/12/2022, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 121' Was it necessary? Denzel Dumfries (Netherlands) is shown a second yellow card for dissent and has to leave the pitch. Antonio Mateu Lahoz had no hesitation in issuing a red card!
121' The lottery of the penalty shootout is over. It was pretty exciting don't you think?
121' GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Lautaro Martinez (Argentina) into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Andries Noppert no chance!
121' Goal! Luuk de Jong (Netherlands) calmly steps up and places the ball into the bottom left corner.
121' Enzo Fernandez (Argentina) fails to convert the penalty kick. His shot goes just wide of the left post.
121' GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Wout Weghorst (Netherlands) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Emiliano Martinez no chance!
121' Goal! Gonzalo Montiel (Argentina) sends the keeper the wrong way and scores into the right side of the goal.
121' GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Teun Koopmeiners (Netherlands) into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Emiliano Martinez no chance!
121' Goal! Leandro Paredes (Argentina) calmly steps up and smashes the ball inside the left post.
121' Steven Berghuis (Netherlands) takes the penalty and sends the ball to the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper pulls off a tremendous diving save to deny him.
121' Goal! Lionel Messi (Argentina) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty low past Andries Noppert into the middle of the goal.
121' Emiliano Martinez anticipates the direction of the penalty by Virgil van Dijk (Netherlands). He attempted to put the ball inside the left post, but the goalkeeper was there in time to deny him.
121' Noa Lang (Netherlands) uses the wrong choice of words while trying to explain something to the referee and receives a yellow card for dissent.
121' Denzel Dumfries (Netherlands) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Antonio Mateu Lahoz's book.
121' It is sometimes said that a penalty kick can only be missed by the taker rather than saved by the goalkeeper. Do you think that will be in the minds of the players today?
120+2' Antonio Mateu Lahoz blows his whistle and ends extra time of today's match. The penalty shoot-out will determine the winner.
120+1' POST! Enzo Fernandez (Argentina) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes against the left post. What a strike that was!
120+1' Angel Di Maria (Argentina) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
120+1' The corner from Angel Di Maria (Argentina) is intercepted by Andries Noppert. Argentina will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
120' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
120' Lionel Messi (Argentina) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked. It will be a corner kick for Argentina.

119' Lautaro Martinez (Argentina) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the left post. Andries Noppert has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
118' Noa Lang (Netherlands) sends a cross into the box, but Emiliano Martinez comes off his line to gather the ball.
116' German Pezzella (Argentina) jumps for a header from the corner kick, but fails to steer the ball into the goal as it flies high over the bar.
116' Angel Di Maria (Argentina) steps up to send the ball in.

116' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Angel Di Maria (Argentina), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. Argentina have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
116' Angel Di Maria (Argentina) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

116' Enzo Fernandez (Argentina) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Argentina will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
115' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Angel Di Maria (Argentina) takes it short.
115' Gonzalo Montiel (Argentina) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee signals a corner kick to Argentina.
115' The resulting corner from Angel Di Maria (Argentina) comes to nothing.

115' A pass lands at the feet of Lautaro Martinez (Argentina) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender. Argentina force their opponents to concede a corner.
113' The substitution is prepared. Noa Lang (Netherlands) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Cody Gakpo.
113' Luuk de Jong (Netherlands) controls the ball from the resulting free kick inside the six-yard box, but his effort is blocked by one of the defending players.
112' Antonio Mateu Lahoz shows the yellow card to German Pezzella (Argentina) for a heavy challenge.
112' Here is a change. Lisandro Martinez is going off and Lionel Scaloni gives the last tactical orders to Angel Di Maria (Argentina).
110' Lionel Messi (Argentina) has a crack at goal from the edge of the box, but it drifts high over the bar to safety.
110' Argentina take the free kick with a short pass.
109' Gonzalo Montiel (Argentina) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
109' The main referee, Antonio Mateu Lahoz, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Gonzalo Montiel (Argentina) is given a yellow card for dissent.
109' Antonio Mateu Lahoz couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Cody Gakpo (Netherlands) and blew his whistle. Argentina win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
108' Luuk de Jong (Netherlands) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
107' Lionel Messi (Argentina) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.
106' Lionel Scaloni makes a half-time substitution. Gonzalo Montiel comes on in place of Nahuel Molina (Argentina).
106' The players must be exhausted and nobody wants the penalty shoot-out. Let's see what second part of extra time can bring. It starts right now!
105+1' Antonio Mateu Lahoz blows for the end of the first period of extra time.
104' Nicolas Otamendi (Argentina) wins the ball from the resulting free kick but scuffs his shot well wide of the left post!
102' A direct free kick from a promising position, taken by Lionel Messi (Argentina), is struck into one of the defending players who deals with the threat.
101' Jurrien Timber (Netherlands) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Antonio Mateu Lahoz has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
100' A cross, provided by Steven Berghuis (Netherlands), caused no threat to the opposition's defence as the ball was cleared out of danger.

98' It looks like Nicolas Otamendi (Argentina) saw red with that tackle. Antonio Mateu Lahoz won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Netherlands.
93' Rough tackle by Cody Gakpo (Netherlands). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
91' The first period of extra-time has just begun.
90+13' Having seen unsporting behavior, Antonio Mateu Lahoz shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Steven Bergwijn (Netherlands) is the recipient.
90+13' The second half has finished, but the result of this match is still yet to be decided.
90+12' Nicolas Otamendi (Argentina) was probably a bit loose with his words to Antonio Mateu Lahoz, who decides to show him a yellow.

90+11' 2 - 2 Wout Weghorst (Netherlands) fires home from close range after he received the ball from the resulting free kick from Teun Koopmeiners. He hits the back of the net with a precise strike and makes it 2:2.
90+10' Lionel Messi (Argentina) is booked for saying more than Antonio Mateu Lahoz was willing to tolerate.
90+10' Antonio Mateu Lahoz blows for a foul after German Pezzella (Argentina) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Netherlands.
90+8' Antonio Mateu Lahoz has a clear sight and sees a foul from Steven Berghuis (Netherlands).
90+5' Cody Gakpo (Netherlands) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
90+3' Steven Berghuis (Netherlands) takes the free kick from the edge of the box, but the goalkeeper perfectly sets up the defensive wall and his effort is thwarted.
90+1' German Pezzella (Argentina) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Netherlands have a free kick from a promising distance.
90' We will have 10 min. of added time.
90' Referee Antonio Mateu Lahoz halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Lionel Scaloni, then shows him a yellow.
89' The foul by Leandro Paredes (Argentina) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Antonio Mateu Lahoz.
88' Antonio Mateu Lahoz shows a yellow card to Steven Berghuis (Netherlands) for a tough tackle.
86' Steven Berghuis (Netherlands) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
85' Steven Berghuis (Netherlands) missed a big chance! He produces a stunning volley from inside the box, but his effort goes not far wide of the right post.

83' 1 - 2 Goal! Steven Berghuis clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Wout Weghorst (Netherlands), who jumps highest and steers a bullet header from the centre of the box into the left side of the goal. Emiliano Martinez had no chance of stopping that. 1:2.
82' A substitution has been made. Julian Alvarez goes off and Lautaro Martinez (Argentina) comes on.
81' Nicolas Tagliafico (Argentina) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
80' Wout Weghorst (Netherlands) commits a foul and Antonio Mateu Lahoz immediately signals a free kick.
78' Louis van Gaal decides to make a substitution. Memphis Depay will be replaced by Wout Weghorst (Netherlands).
78' Lionel Scaloni prepares a substitution. Cristian Gabriel Romero is replaced by German Pezzella (Argentina).
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nicolas Tagliafico (Argentina) comes onto the pitch for Marcos Acuna.
77' PENALTY APPEAL after Cody Gakpo (Netherlands) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
76' Lisandro Martinez (Argentina) earns the yellow card.
76' The whistle is blown for an infringement and Memphis Depay (Netherlands) receives a yellow card!
73' 0 - 2 Goal! Lionel Messi (Argentina) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Andries Noppert into right side of the goal.
72' Lionel Messi (Argentina) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
71' Denzel Dumfries (Netherlands) trips an opposition player and Antonio Mateu Lahoz signals a foul. The advantage of a penalty kick is given to Argentina.
70' The attendance for today's match is 88966.
68' Lionel Messi (Argentina) commits a rough challenge and Antonio Mateu Lahoz blows his whistle for a foul.
67' Lionel Scaloni has decided to substitute Rodrigo de Paul and he is replaced by Leandro Paredes (Argentina).
64' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Daley Blind trots off the pitch and is replaced by Luuk de Jong (Netherlands).

63' Lionel Messi (Argentina) attempts to threaten the goalkeeper from the free kick on the edge of the box. He produces a stunning blast which only flies inches over the crossbar. It could have been a beautiful goal!
61' Virgil van Dijk (Netherlands) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Argentina are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
59' Virgil van Dijk (Netherlands) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
56' The shots on goal statistics – 0:3.
54' Daley Blind (Netherlands) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
51' Rodrigo de Paul (Argentina) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Andries Noppert comes off the line to clear the ball away.
49' Cody Gakpo (Netherlands) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Emiliano Martinez, who smothers the ball.
48' Lionel Messi (Argentina) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
47' Marcos Acuna (Argentina) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. The referee blows his whistle, Argentina are awarded a corner kick.
46' Half-time substitution. Louis van Gaal decided to make a change. Marten de Roon (Netherlands) is replaced by Teun Koopmeiners.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Steven Bergwijn (Netherlands) comes off for Steven Berghuis.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+7' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Marten de Roon (Netherlands) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Antonio Mateu Lahoz blows for a foul.
45+2' Wout Weghorst (Netherlands) gets a yellow card, off the field.
45+1' Cody Gakpo (Netherlands) sends a cross into the box from the free kick, but Emiliano Martinez leaps into the air and clears the danger.
45' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Cristian Gabriel Romero (Argentina) is awarded a yellow card.
45' Cody Gakpo (Netherlands) dinks a cross into the box from the free kick. However, the opposition defence thwarts the attack, preventing anyone from finishing.
43' Marcos Acuna (Argentina) will miss the next game.
43' Marcos Acuna (Argentina) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Antonio Mateu Lahoz didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
43' Jurrien Timber (Netherlands) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
41' Cody Gakpo (Netherlands) takes the free kick which is dealt with by the opposition defence.
40' Enzo Fernandez (Argentina) commits a rough foul. Antonio Mateu Lahoz stops the game and makes a call. Netherlands win a free kick.
40' Lionel Messi (Argentina) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it to the middle of the goal, but Andries Noppert makes a comfortable save to stop his effort.
38' Rodrigo de Paul (Argentina) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
37' Rodrigo de Paul (Argentina) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
35' 0 - 1 Nahuel Molina (Argentina) receives a precise pass inside the box from Lionel Messi and he beats the goalkeeper with a neat finish into the left side of the net. 0:1.
33' Rodrigo de Paul (Argentina) attempts to score with a first-time shot from the edge of the box. His effort towards the middle of the goal is saved by Andries Noppert.
29' Cody Gakpo (Netherlands) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
27' Lisandro Martinez (Argentina) takes a short free kick.
26' Antonio Mateu Lahoz blows his whistle. Jurrien Timber (Netherlands) commits a foul after dangerous play. A free kick has been awarded to Argentina.
24' A wild effort from Steven Bergwijn (Netherlands) on the edge of the box flies well wide of the right post.
22' Lionel Messi (Argentina) cuts inside after a good run and goes for glory from the edge of the box. The shot, though, flies high over the bar into row Z.
21' Cody Gakpo (Netherlands) works the corner short.
21' Memphis Depay (Netherlands) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Netherlands.
18' Emiliano Martinez displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Steven Bergwijn (Netherlands) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
15' Cristian Gabriel Romero (Argentina) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
13' Rodrigo de Paul (Argentina) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Andries Noppert intercepts the ball.
10' A pass by Marcos Acuna (Argentina) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
9' Memphis Depay (Netherlands) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Cody Gakpo.
6' Virgil van Dijk (Netherlands) sends a long ball forward to Cody Gakpo, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.
5' Rodrigo de Paul (Argentina) takes a first-time shot from the edge of the box, but his own player gets in the way and blocks it.
2' Marcos Acuna (Argentina) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Netherlands will take the kick-off.
